title: Who keeps CCS data alive? A call for more data sharing at the gigaCCS Consortium Days
summary: A panel at the 2026 gigaCCS Consortium Days argued that too many CCS datasets disappear when projects end. It made the case for open data and a new model to keep data available.
why_it_matters: Network optimisation depends on cost, capacity and operational data; better CCS data sharing in Norway could improve inputs for supply-chain models.
